title: Gold Rush: White Water
description: As winter starts to show its teeth, Dustin and his crew fight to find bedrock and the $100,000 in gold he needs to avoid selling his claims; a burnt-out winch causes rocks to pile up in the dive hole increasing tensions between Dustin and Danielle.

title: Along Central Asia's Great Rivers
description: Arriving at the dry seabed of the shrinking Aral Sea, Kate makes the first-ever bicycle journey around its shores.

title: Live to Farm
description: Go inside the lives of America's top farmers as they navigate the challenges, risks and rewards of modern agriculture; from planting to harvest, follow real farming families as they work to produce the food that feeds the world.

title: Caught!
description: Serving others is a noble cause, unless it's in the service industry; between bad customers and broken machines, it can be a total nightmare.

title: Caught!
description: By land, air, rail or sea -- with so many ways to travel, one'd think it would be a breeze; but leave it to fellow travelers to bring one to one's knees, causing unexpected turmoil along the way.

title: Caught!
description: The average person spends nearly 90,000 hours of their life at work; from contractor showdowns and unexpected explosions to battling coworkers, a workday feels like an epic rollercoaster ride.

title: Caught!
description: When jewel thieves get stuck in a shop, a fleeing carjacker hides in a port-a-potty, and a criminal tries to escape in a 20-ton construction vehicle, the law fights back and puts them behind bars.

title: Caught!
description: Security cameras in front yards, backyards, storefronts and street corners capture crimes, mishaps and earth-shattering moments like break-ins. When lives are at risk, it is up to local law enforcement and communities to save the day.

title: Caught!
description: In the world of air travel, crime and misconduct are skyrocketing, causing unruly travelers to be denied boarding; protesting passengers create turbulence for everyone on board; when mechanical issues arise, the real chaos begins.

title: Caught!
description: Holidays highlight unique traditions, but when clashing personalities and lots of alcohol get mixed, mayhem and memorable stories are sure to follow.

title: Caught!
description: Shopping trips are part of everyone's daily routines, but if tensions flare between angry customers and fed-up workers, it can result in more than just damaged goods.

description: A rookie security manager on his first graveyard shift struggles to keep up with an escalating barrage of bizarre calls, ringing one after another; meanwhile, a late-night VIP pickup turns into a cross-town odyssey full of unexpected detours.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description: Reports of loud bangs and bullet holes on the eighth floor spark a tense night before the cause of the chaos is discovered one floor above; a VIP host loses her most valuable client and puts all her hopes of making her monthly quota on a walk-in whale.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description: A big music festival takes over Las Vegas and brings nearly-naked guests, packed rooms and non-stop partying to the Nugget; a disturbance call in the hotel sparks tension between guests as a desperate chip thief risks returning to the casino to cash in.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description: Four unique weddings in one day stretch the Golden Nugget's wedding team to their limit; a crack in the 200,000-gallon shark tank raises the alarm; stolen casino keys cause chaos; security breaks up a rowdy wedding party of seniors.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description: The annual blackjack tournament lures more than big money to the Nugget; it becomes an opportunity to nab notorious thieves; while a VIP host faces a crowd-shy high roller, security hunts down a slot thief and sets a trap for a serial hotel room burglar.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description: A high roller demands the return of his favorite slot machine as security goes undercover to catch hustlers targeting casino guests; a poolside confrontation spirals out of control, stretching the Golden Nugget team thin.

title: Expedition Unknown
description: Diving into Lake Superior, Josh has brand-new intel that may finally solve a 100-year-old mystery: the resting place of two WW1 minesweepers; on their way to combat German mines in the Atlantic, the warships sank and took the lives of 79 sailors.

title: Expedition Unknown
description: Josh digs deep into the swamp to hunt the lost fortune of notorious bootleggers and bank robbers the Ashley Gang; Josh needs to retrace the outlaw family's criminal empire, which included a blood feud with the local Florida sheriff.

title: Expedition Unknown
description: In a two-part investigation, Josh Gates travels the globe attempting to solve the most fundamental mystery of all humanity's origins.

title: Expedition Unknown

title: Expedition Unknown
description: Josh chases the treasure of legendary Viking Harald Bluetooth Gormsson; the discovery of a mysterious gold artifact sends Josh on a journey through Scandinavia and into remote northern European forests to uncover Bluetooth's tomb and fortune.

title: Expedition Unknown
description: Josh helps recover the richest stash of lost treasure in the Americas; deploying cutting-edge technology and an armada of boats, the team dives the Caribbean to bring coins and jewels from the legendary Spanish galleon Maravillas to the surface.

title: Expedition Unknown
description: Josh Gates treks into Colombia's deadly jungle to unravel the El Dorado myth and retrace the steps of Spanish conquistadors; Josh meets with the tribe that inspired the legend of a city of gold and unearths its treasure in a surprising location.

description: The hunt for El Dorado is Josh's most grueling journey ever, and one of the crew tumbles into a raging river; when cutting-edge aerial scans reveal a lost city, the crew pushes into the jungle to uncover El Dorado and the gold that comes with it.

description: Dozer Dave bets his life savings that he can unearth piles of gold from an abandoned mine using salvaged equipment and a team of amateur miners.

description: Dave faces a nightmare scenario when the ground he's mining goes cold and no one knows why; with his season hanging in the balance, the pressure mounts for Dave to get them back on the gold.

title: Moonshiners
description: For America's 250th anniversary, Tim and Tickle produce revolutionary-era moonshine; Digger questions Mark's attempt at his ancestor's sour corn whiskey; Josh and Jerry's plans fail.

title: Moonshiners
description: As Tim and Tickle add molasses to their 18th-century mash bill and heat their vintage copper still with wood fire, Howard takes the revolutionary spirit too far. Demand for Josh's shine outpaces supply as Jerry opens a new front in his war with Mike.

title: Guided: The Reel Story of Louisiana Guides
description: Captures the skill, determination and passion it takes to succeed in one of Louisiana's most demanding outdoor professions; from predawn starts and the relentless search for fish to battling Mother Nature, these guides face pressure every day.

title: Tomorrow's World Today
description: George sends Greg to the World of Innovation for a behind-the-scenes look at a modern steelmaking facility, where cutting-edge technology and a new generation of skilled professionals are transforming one of America's most essential industries.

title: Gold Rush
description: A virus rips through Parker's camp; Tony's son Mike breaks through icy overburden at the Hester Cut; Buzz buys an ancient trommel buried in the bush.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description: A rare northern outbreak draws veteran chasers across the Canadian border into unfamiliar territory. Back on home turf, Freddy, Tanner, and Connor race across Nebraska in pursuit of a powerful, long-lived twister that earns the title Tornado of the Year.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description: Near Gary, S.D., expert chasers and certified weather spotters self-shoot an encounter with a long-track, shape-shifting tornado; when the twister takes a turn towards an occupied farmhouse, chasers are thrust into the role of first responders.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description: Teams of expert storm chasers and certified weather spotters risk it all to venture into America's Tornado Alley; they self-shoot their encounters with nature at its most extreme, warn people in harm's way and help save lives when disaster strikes.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description: Six teams of chasers pursue a violent tornado outbreak in North Dakota; but as day turns to night, the storm unleashes the first EF5 tornado in over a decade; as the mile-wide monster levels homes and farms, chasers race to rescue people and pets.

title: Naked and Afraid: Last One Standing
description: Matt's tactics spark tension in another camp; survivalists compete in a primitive axe challenge; after the first big-game kill, a competitor must choose to keep or share their win; physical and mental strain of the challenge sends a survivalist home.

title: Naked and Afraid: Last One Standing
description: Pushed to the brink, three competitors send shockwaves through the Outback; all camps are disbanded and challenges going forward will be solo tests; hunting competition offers a protein reward; medics are called when a survivalist steps on hot coals.

title: Naked and Afraid: Last One Standing
description: In a rocket stove challenge, a worst-to-first comeback by a dark horse secures a critical asset; a survivalist gets a big-game kill and plots to shift the balance of power; a top contender's shocking exit rocks the competition.

title: Naked and Afraid: Last One Standing
description: The friction fire challenge shakes everyone; Patrick is stunned when he must give up his gathered materials; Cheeny has an edge, but her strategy risks it all; Matt's blistered hands could send him home; one survivalist is eliminated.
